facts.text: AAURoverEnv-v0 is registered with entry_point 'rover_envs.envs.navigation.entrypoints:RoverEnv' and disable_env_checker=True
The navigation task is configured with sim.dt 1/30 s, decimation 6 and episode_length_s 150
The action term has action_dim 2, commented as a linear velocity and an angular velocity
AckermannAction.process_actions computes the processed action as raw action times scale plus offset
The AAU rover task sets wheelbase_length 0.849, middle_wheel_distance 0.894, rear_and_front_wheel_distance 0.77, wheel_radius 0.1, min_steering_radius 0.8 and offset -0.0135
The observation group concatenates the last action, distance to target (scale 0.11), heading (scale 1/pi), angle difference (scale 1/pi) and the height scan (scale 1)
The height scanner uses GridPatternCfg(resolution=0.05, size=[5.0, 5.0]) with max_distance=100.0
The height scan is the sensor height minus the ray hit height minus 0.26878, the distance between the sensor and the rover's base
Targets are sampled on a circle of that radius around the environment origin with a uniformly random angle
The position command resamples every 150.0 s and its heading command is uniform in (-pi, pi)
The task terminates on timeout, on success with a distance threshold of 0.18 and a contact force threshold of 1.0
The success test requires the distance to be below the configured threshold and the absolute heading error to be below 0.1 rad

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the target and the next episode; the analytic dynamics are deterministic. The fake draws its targets with Python's random.Random and the upstream target sampler uses torch.rand (terrain_importer.py:208), so a seed gives different trajectories on the two.

gaps: F0 analytic model: simulated positions are integrated directly from the two action values; there is no rigid-body dynamics, no contact, friction, actuator or sensor model, and the wheel-level Ackermann mapping of ackermann_actions.py:91-96 is not applied

the height-scan observation (a 5.0 m by 5.0 m grid at 0.05 m resolution, rover_env_cfg.py:106-114) is not modelled: the fake publishes the last action and the three target terms and omits the scan array

the eight reward terms (rover_env_cfg.py:199-241) and the timeout, success, far-from-target and collision terminations (rover_env_cfg.py:244-261) are not modelled; the fake returns reward 0 and never reports terminated or truncated
the clone states no numeric action bounds (the Isaac Lab base outside the repository owns the space); the fake publishes an unbounded Box and the bridge derives no action-value limit
the terrain, the spawn-location sampling, the random spawn yaw and the reset options are not modelled: the fake starts at the origin with yaw 0
the fake was not compared with the upstream Isaac Sim environment, which was not run (it needs Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab and a GPU); observations, rewards and random streams differ
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
